adjudicator_sentence: Renaming or removing a schema field without updating the SQLite migration allowlist directly breaks runtime column mapping during database operations.
Altering JSON field definitions in MemoryItemSchema without maintaining parity in OBSERVATION_JSON_FIELDS causes worker serialization silently to omit or corrupt payload fields.
Modifying MemoryItemSchema field keys without syncing indexedFields breaks full-text and substring search queries against SQLite memory tables.
Renaming a field in pricingFieldsSchema without updating PRICING_FIELDS breaks form rendering and value mapping in the pricing settings UI dashboard.
Diverging updateProviderConnectionSchema validation parameters from CONNECTION_COLUMNS causes query execution failures on resilience connection endpoints.
Diverging pricing fields between the Zod validation schema and catalogUserPricing.ts causes bulk SQLite loading logic to omit expected user pricing overrides.
Omitting or renaming fields between the update connection schema and the DB optionalFields allowlist causes provider updates silently to set properties to NULL upon persistence.
NON_TOKEN_FIELDS models non-token pricing metrics (per second, per image, per character), which are disjoint from pricingFieldsSchema's core token pricing metrics (input, output, cached).
Mismatches between connection update validation and cooldownManager.ts COLUMNS cause cooldown status resets to query or update invalid database fields.
